name: Crash Landing
source:
With your spaceship you crash land on an undiscovered planet, dazed and confused, a tribe finds you not knowing what you are. You later discover that they are a resistance fighting against an oppressive empire, but could there be more behind all of this? After all It’s quite strange that your spaceship received catastrophic damage out of nowhere.

[From [url=https://nikofurry-buniko.itch.io/crash-landing]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你的飞船坠毁在一颗尚未被发现的星球上。昏沉迷茫之际，一个部落发现了你，却不知道你究竟是什么。后来你才得知，他们是一支反抗暴虐帝国的抵抗军。但这一切背后，会不会还另有隐情？毕竟，你的飞船竟然毫无征兆地遭到毁灭性损伤，这本身就很蹊跷。

[摘自[url=https://nikofurry-buniko.itch.io/crash-landing]Itch.io[/url]]
